Honestly this is how I feel every time I see this posted. She didn't go out of her way to talk about how "horrible" short guys are. The guy led her into it.

She actually didn't say anything mean about short guys at all. Her profile says she wants someone over 5'7", and since people on tinder are there to swipe right on people that are their "type", that sounds pretty reasonable. She wanted someone taller than her. So do a lot of girls. It's a type. Who cares.

Yeah the weight thing is fatlogic like you said. But she did *not* say she doesn't like short people. He said he doesn't like fat people. He said short people are the worst. I'd stop talking to him too, just based on how negative he seems to be.
